Tiny C Book

1. Printing

C prints with printf. The text goes in double quotes and the slash n at the end starts a new line.

#include <stdio.h>

int main(void) {
    printf("Hello from C\n");
    return 0;
}

2. Math

C does arithmetic with the usual signs. Remember that dividing two whole numbers throws away the remainder.

#include <stdio.h>

int main(void) {
    int a = 17;
    int b = 5;
    printf("%d\n", a / b);
    printf("%d\n", a % b);
    return 0;
}
